div.div:
Notation
X: last 24 h of all nodes (23 sensor + 7 weather features) · xi: last 24 h of node i
R̄: city-wide level now · R̂ ∈ ℝ6: forecast city-wide change · ŶT: cloud graph model forecast
bi: broadcast input · di: consensus level · mi: node memory (usual offset per clock hour) ★
s⊙ci: local correction · ŷi = R̂ + s⊙ci: change of PM2.5 and PM10 at +1, +2, +3 h
★ new in this work · - - ▶ upload / triggered message

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #111111;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Arial; color: light-dark(#111111, #dfdfdf); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Training (offline; Y = reference CPCB PM, used only as target)
Cloud graph model: LT = Huber(ŶT, Y) + pinball loss on the 10–90 % band
Regional forecaster: out-of-fold over 2-year blocks
Box model: LS = Huber(ŷi, Y), optional cloud matching to ŶT
